news.title: Samsung Brings Advanced Generative AI to Mid-Tier Smartphones in 2026
news.snippet: Samsung Electronics is expanding its advanced generative AI features to a wider range of mid-tier and budget smartphones and tablets, previously reserved for flagship models.
